records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Logistics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Rafael reached first project day 0 and replied positively on day 5 ([email:f53426ae]), showing real engagement and no blockers or tickets. But no invite sent and key milestone unreached 6 days in, solo Starter usage, with 8 days left — momentum exists but activation isn't clearly imminent.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Glad to hear the first project is starting to click — that's the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so once the shape feels right it tends to carry the rest of the work.

One thing that often helps at this stage is bringing a colleague in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
